scope: Proposition 4.1 (Quadratic covariance bound) of the manuscript “An Isolated Particle Pole for the Two-Dimensional O(3) Spin Field” (preprints/An-Isolated-Particle-Pole-for-the-Two-Dimensional-O3-Spin-Field-October-4-2026/o3-particle-pole.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 215 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 302c6b61d389fbb9), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 10. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let P and Q be monomials in spin components for the law (4.1), of even total degrees r and s, with nonempty site lists A and B. Put G = max x∈A, y∈B E(q3 xq3 y). There is a constant Cr,s, depending only on the two degrees, such that | Cov(P, Q)| ≤ Cr,sG2 . (4.2) If either monomial is constant, its covariance is zero.
